Name: Bigger Backpack Plus
Author: glnn30
Description:
[center][b][font=Arial Black][size=5][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/55258/55258-1794176892-1191103468.png[/img] [/size][size=6]Bigger Backpack Plus[/size][size=5] [img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/55258/55258-1794176892-1191103468.png[/img][/size]
[/font][/b][/center]
This mod gives you another way to upgrade Backpack way past the 36 slot limit. Because we want more spaces. This is based on BiggerBackpack made by bcmpinc which currently not updated.

[size=4][b]⚙️Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]1. Uninstall any backpack upgrade mods that you have including the config.json[/color][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]2. Download the mod[/color][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]3. Extract it to you Stardew Valley mod folder[/color][/size]

[size=4][b]⭐️ Main features[/b][/size]
1. Offers up to 72 slots (max of 6 rows) 
2. Add base price multipliers for more challenging mode.
3. Flexible row shifting, so you can navigate your toolbar at ease. (You can shift your toolbar up and down by pressing specific key)

[size=4]🎒Base Price:[/size]
[size=4]24 slots =  2,000g[/size]
[size=4]36 slots = 10,000g[/size]
[size=4]48 slots = 50,000g[/size]
[size=4]60 slots = 100,000g[/size]
[size=4]72 slots = 250,000g[/size]

Compatible with UI info Suite 2 and Alternative

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url][/color][/size]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3213]StardewHack[/url]
